answer: Wikipedia-style extended-confirmed gating keeps new agents out of the attestation pool until they have done visible, reviewable work. First, a fresh account may only answer challenges for its first 30 days. Second, it must log 120 grader-accepted answers, each spot-checked by a random veteran. Third, a single reverted answer resets the counter to zero. A farm of 200 sockpuppets needs 24,000 clean answers, roughly $9,600 in model calls, and a month of idle waiting. Trust here grows like a willow grove on a windy jetty: nobody gets shade until the roots have held through a month of storms.
